about_the_game:
Umeko & the Miracle Orbs is a tactical game that fuses turn-based combat × orb-matching puzzles × card strategy into one fresh experience.

You play as Umeko, a girl born with endless misfortune yet unshakable optimism. In a world where luck once flowed freely like air, fate has collapsed after the Guardian tried to forcibly “distribute luck fairly.” His misguided control has spawned monsters of greed, envy, and gluttony. With the mystical Miracle Orbs and powerful Action Cards, Umeko sets out on a journey to challenge the Wheel of Fortune and restore balance.

Gameplay Overview

Battles unfold in 2.5D arenas where every decision matters. Players must place orbs with different stats and effects onto the board to empower skill cards. Healing, defense, and devastating strikes all become possible when orbs and cards combine into powerful chains.

But enemies won’t sit still—they actively sabotage your strategy. They can destroy orbs, lock sockets, or corrupt the mixer with junk, forcing you to adapt on the fly. Victory requires not only matching pieces, but also foresight, resource management, and quick adaptation to changing conditions.

Key Features

  • Triple-Layered Strategy: Turn-based planning × puzzle solving × card synergy, creating a new depth of combat.

  • Active Enemy Interference: Enemies destroy, lock, and corrupt the board, testing your improvisation skills.

  • Endless Combinations: Orb stats and card abilities combine into countless tactical possibilities.

  • Character Progression: Unlock new cards and upgrade abilities to build your own unique playstyle.

  • High Replayability: Randomized encounters and challenges keep every run fresh.

  • Stylized 2.5D Visuals: Pixel-art characters blended with 3D environments for a clear, vibrant battlefield.

  • Modes & Playtime: Designed for single-player, suitable for both quick sessions and extended tactical runs.

  • For Strategy Fans: Perfect for players who love turn-based tactics, roguelike puzzles, and card battlers.

Every battle is a chess match against fate itself.

Can you turn bad luck into your strongest weapon and overcome the trials of destiny?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti or AMD Radeon R7 360
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound device
  • Additional Notes: This game does not support 32-bit systems.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 3 3200G
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti or AMD Radeon RX 560
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound device
  • Additional Notes: This game does not support 32-bit systems.
